name: 레온
motion_summary: Eternal Return Leon Surf's Up: athletic brown-haired boy, bright focused blue eyes, blue/white sporty water outfit and headset from exact identity. R summons a wave and RIDES it forward, then leaves a puddle. No surfboard (he uses his body), no real ocean scene. 12 poses: ready; spread hands down; knees bend as water rises; blue curling wave grows beneath rear foot; arms forward and lean onto wave; wave carries him forward with balanced bent knees; wave crest and torso tilted right; body stretched into final push; wave breaks in contained white-blue splash below shoulders; drop into small puddle; stand and lower arms as puddle shrinks; ready. Preserve his face clear above water. Floor/camera origin fixed, body can rise with wave; generous margins and cyan/blue square splash pixels.
visual_review: 푸른 눈·헤드셋·스포츠 복장을 유지하며 파도 소환, 타기, 균형, 붕괴 후 착지가 나타납니다.
